sources_considered.why: Identifies the reported task but supplies no independent causal evidence.
Provides relevant mechanistic context about learned representations, while studying different models and tasks.
Its verification experiments do not identify the cause of the reported British prime minister errors.

evidence_items.explanation: The study finds structured representations in Llama-2 models, cautioning against inferring the absence of representations from text generation alone. It does not establish what GPT-5 represented or used in the British prime minister task.
